items.title: American Water Works (AWK) Launched A New Monterey Peninsula Groundwater Well
items.summary: American Water Works Company (NYSE:AWK) subsidiary California American Water has commissioned ASR Well 4 on the Monterey Peninsula. The new groundwater production well is paired with a mercury treatment facility designed to help meet strict drinking water standards. The project increases groundwater production capacity for the Monterey Peninsula system and is intended to support long term resilience.
